propositions: Reconcile Bridge failures running on GitHub Actions produce zero CloudWatch signal and are invisible to monitoring until manually reviewed in workflow run logs
GitHub Actions workflow requires job-level id-token:write permission and OIDC credential configuration to assume an AWS role capable of publishing metrics to CloudWatch
A new IAM role rebar-bridge-metrics must grant only cloudwatch:PutMetricData scoped to rebar/host namespace via conditional policy, federating existing GitHub OIDC provider

The workflow must publish bridge_run_failures=1 on failure() and 0 on success() with period=3600 and threshold=1 to alarm on second failure within an hour, distinguishing sustained outages from transient blips
Publishing 0 on success rather than omitting success datapoints keeps the publisher itself observable and transitions alarm to OK rather than INSUFFICIENT_DATA
